MOZ.note: The deck mentions data centers for POPs only as a jobs point; it states no data centre for hire in Mozambique.
States no rural connection programme with counted sites and no rural and urban survey figures; the Gorongosa Park VSAT case is not a government programme.
States nothing about a nationally owned data centre for hire.

facts.fact: INCM (Joaquim Zindoga) states Starlink was approved in under a year, the first in Africa, under fast-track licensing.
INCM states the market is hybrid, with SATCOM (500+ VSATs, established 1999) competing with Starlink, whose rural broadband it contrasts with SATCOM's.
